title: Next Level Perfect Pitch (8 Year Old)
summary: Rick Beato tests his 8-year-old son Dylan's perfect pitch on single notes, note pairs and complex polychords.
why: Used as the canonical example of striking absolute pitch in children in discussions on how perfect pitch is acquired.

quote.text: Rick Beato has at least one child with absolute pitch with stunning ability to name chords and the discrete notes in them.
